senses.gloss: Recalcitrant,Ⓒa.ⒹSee Refractory under Refract.

Recall,Ⓒv. t.ⒹpratyAhve 1 P, ni-pratyA-vft c., pratyAnI 1 P, pratyAdA 3 A.
Ⓑ
 2 (To mind) smf 1 P, anuciMt 10.
Ⓑ
 3 vi-lup 6 P or c., nivft c., pratyAnI, KaMq 10, niras 4 U, pra-tyAdiS 6 P.
Ⓔs.ⒹpratyAhvAnaM, nivartanaM, pratyAnayanaM, pratyAdAnaM.

Recant,Ⓒv. t.ⒹpratyAKyA 2 P, pratyAdiS 6 P, KaMq 10, vilup c.
Ⓝ[Recant]ation,Ⓒs.ⒹpratyAKyAnaM, pratyAdeSaH, KaMqanaM, vilopaH, viparIta-vAdaH.

Recapitulate,Ⓒv. t.ⒹsaMkzepataH kaT 10 or varR 10, vizayasAraM varR, BAzaRasAraM anuvad 1 P.
Ⓝ[Recapitulat]ion,Ⓒs.ⒹsaMkzepataH varRanaM, saMkzepeRa anuvAdaH; (of past events) siMhAvalokanaM.

Recede,Ⓒv. i.Ⓓapasf 1 P, apA-parA-ni-vft 1 A, apasfp 1 P, apakram 1 U, 4 P, apa-gam 1 P, apa-yA-i 2 P.
Ⓝ[Reced]ing,Ⓒs.ⒹapasaraRaM, apakramaRaM, apayAnaM, &c.

Receive,Ⓒv. t.ⒹA-dA 3 A, prati-iz 6 P, grah 9 U, prati-pari-°, prati-A-pad 4 A, svIkf 8 U, aMgIkf.
Ⓑ
 2 Ap 5 P, aDigam 1 P, laB 1 A; See Get.
Ⓑ
 3 praviS c.; See Admit.
Ⓑ
 4 (A guest) pratyud-gam-vraj 1 P, pratyud-i-yA 2 P, saM-man c., saM-BU c., satkf, A 6 A, svAgataM vad 1 P or vyAhf 1 P.
Ⓑ
 5 A-DA 3 U, grah, A-dA, Df 1 P, 10.
Ⓝ[Receiv]ed,Ⓒa.ⒹAdatta, Atta, gfhIta, labDa, satkfta, saMBAvita, &c.
Ⓑ
 2 lokaprasidDa, aBimata, pra-calita, aByupeta; ‘r(eceived) practice’ lokAcAraH, pracalito vyavahAraH; ‘r(eceived) doctrine’ AmnAyaH, saMpradAyaH.
Ⓝ[Receiv]er, Recipient,Ⓒs.ⒹpratigrAhakaH, pari-prati-grAhin, grahItf, AdAtf all m. pratIcCakaH.
Ⓑ
 2 ASayaH, ADAraH, BAjanaM, ni-A-DAnaM.
ⓃReceipt,Ⓒs.ⒹAdAnaM, grahaRaM, prApti f.
Ⓑ
 2 AyaH, lABaH, udayaH, PalaM, AgamaH, AdAyaH.
Ⓑ
 3 svIkArapatraM, aByupagamaleKaH, pratigrahapatraM-leKaH; ‘or the creditor shall give a r(eceipt) in his own hand’ DanI vopagataM dadyAt (DanaM) svahastaparicihnitaM (Y. ii. 93).
Ⓑ
 4 (Recipe) yogaH, kalpaH, saMskAraleKaH.
ⓃReceptacle,Ⓒs.ⒹADAraH, A-ni-DAnaM, BAjanaM, ASayaH, pAtraM, niDiH, ASrayaH, AspadaM, padaM; ‘r(eceptacle) of bile’ pittASayaH; AmASayaH, &c.
ⓃReception,Ⓒs.Ⓓpari-prati-grahaH, AdAnaM, grahaRaM, svI-aMgI-kAraH, praveSaH-SanaM.
Ⓑ
 2 saMBAvanA, upacAraH, pratyudgamaH, satkAraH, saMmAnaH, AdaraH.

Recent,Ⓒa.Ⓓnava, aBinava, nUtana, pratyagra, acira, aprAcIna, adIrGakAlIna.
Ⓝ[Recent]ly,Ⓒadv.ⒹSee Lately.
Receptacle, Reception,ⒶSee under Receive.

Recess,Ⓒs.ⒹviviktaM sTAnaM, nigUQasTAnaM; koRaH, niBfta-gupta-sTAnaM.
Ⓑ
 2 nirvfti-viSrAma-sTAnaM, ArAmaH.
Ⓑ
 3 virAmaH, viSrAMti f., kzaRaH, kArya-tyAgaH-nivftti f., viSrAmaH, viSrAmakAlaH.

Recipe,Ⓒs.ⒹSee Receipt.
Ⓑ
 4 under Receive.

Reciprocal,Ⓒa.Ⓓanyonya, paraspara, itaretara, vyatikara, miTaH, in comp.; oft. ex. by vyati pr.; See Mutual.
Ⓑ
 2 anyonyAnugAmin, parasparAnuvartin, anupUrva.
Ⓝ[Reciprocal]ly,Ⓒadv.ⒹparasparaM, itaretaraM, miTaH.
Ⓝ[Reciprocal]ness, Reciprocity,Ⓒs.ⒹparasparatA, vyatikaraH, vyatizaMgaH, vyati(tI)hAraH, vinimayaH, pari(rI)vartaH.
ⓃReciprocate,Ⓒv. t.ⒹparasparaM parivft c., vinime 1 A, vyatihf 1 P; ‘to r(eciprocate) assistance’ pratyupakf 8 U; See Exchange.
Ⓝ[Reciprocat]ion,Ⓒs.ⒹvinimayaH, vyatihAraH, parivartaH.

Recite,Ⓒv. t.ⒹpaW 1 P, udIr c., uccar c., anuvad 1 P, udAhf 1 P, ud-gF 6 P.
Ⓑ
 2 varR 10, kaT 10, AKyA 2 P, vyAhf; See Tell.
Ⓝ[Recit]al, [Recit]ation,Ⓒs.ⒹpaWanaM, udAhAraH, udgAraH, uccAraRaM, anuvAdaH.
Ⓑ
 2 kaTanaM, AKyAnaM, varRanaM.
Ⓝ[Recit]er,Ⓒs.ⒹpaWakaH, anuvAdakaH, uccArakaH, AKyAyakaH.

Reck,Ⓒv. i.ⒹgaR 10, avekz 1 A; See Care.
Ⓝ[Reck]less,Ⓒa.Ⓓpramatta, anavahita, asAvaDAna, nirape(ve)kza, sAhasin.
Ⓝ[Reck]lessly,Ⓒadv.ⒹasAvaDAnaM, pramAdena, niHSaMkaM, avicArya.
Ⓝ[Reck]lessness,Ⓒs.ⒹpramAdaH, anavaDAnaM, sAhasaM, sAhasaSIlatA.

Reckon,Ⓒv. t.ⒹgaR 10, pari-saM-KyA 2 P, kal 10 (kalayati).
Ⓑ
 2 man 4 A, gaR, BU c.
Ⓔv. i.Ⓓvi-, tark 10, anu-mA 3 A, 2 P, Uh 1 A.
Ⓑ
 2 man, buD 1 P; See Consider; ‘r(eckon) upon’ A-ava-laMb 1 A, ASri 1 U, viSvas 2 P; ‘r(eckon) with’ deyaM pariSuD c.
Ⓝ[Reckon]er,Ⓒs.ⒹgaRakaH, gaRayitf m.
Ⓝ[Reckon]ing,Ⓒs.ⒹgaRanaM-nA, pari-, saMKyAnaM.
Ⓑ
 2 gaRanApatraM.
Ⓑ
 3 vyayapatraM.
Ⓑ
 4 mAnaM, gaRanA, mAtrA.

Reclaim,Ⓒv. t.ⒹsatpaTe-sanmArge-pravft c. or nI 1 P, or niyuj 7 A, 10, durmArgAt-duzkarmaRaH-ni-parA-vft c. or viram c., durmArgaM tyaj c.
Ⓑ
 2 kfziyogya- a. kf 8 U.
Ⓑ
 3 punaH laB 1 A or grah 9 U.
ⓃReclamation,Ⓒs.ⒹpApanivftti f., durmArgaparAvartanaM; kupaTatyAgaH.
Ⓑ
 2 punargrahaRaM; punarlABaH-avApti f.

Recline,Ⓒv. t.Ⓓava-A-laMb 1 A, samA-A-Sri 1 U.
Ⓑ
 2 SI 2 A, saM-upa-viS 6 P, As 2 A; aDyAs, aDi-SI (with acc.), nizad 1 P, viSram 4 P; See Lie.
Ⓔv. t.Ⓓni-DA 3 U, upa-DA; See Lean.
Ⓝ[Reclin]ing,Ⓒa.ⒹAlaMbin, ASrita, avalaMbita.
Ⓑ
 2 A-ava-namra; SayAna; saMvizwa, nizaRRa.

Recluse,Ⓒs.ⒹparivrAj m., saMnyAsin m., vi-vikta-ekAMta-vAsin-sevin m., vAnaprasTaH; ‘female r(ecluse)’ parivrAjikA.
Ⓔa.Ⓓvivikta, nirjana See Lonely.
Ⓝ[Recluse]ness,Ⓒs.ⒹAraRya-kavrataM, viviktasevA, parivrajanaM.

Recognize,Ⓒv. t.Ⓓprati-, aBijYA 9 U, saMvid 2 A, paricCid 7 P, anu-smf 1 P, niSci 5 U, nirRI 1 P; ‘not properly r(ecogniz)ed’ na tattvataH paricCinnaH.
Ⓑ
 2 svI-aMgI-kf 8 U, prati-pad 4 A, aByupagam 1 P, aByupa-i 2 P, grah 9 U, pramARIkf.
Ⓝ[Recogniz]ance,Ⓒs.ⒹaMgIkArapatraM, prAtiBAvyaM, darSanaprAtiBAvyaM (‘r(ecognizance) bond’); ‘entered into a r(ecognizance) bond’ darSanapratiBuvaM dadO.
ⓃRecognition,Ⓒs.Ⓓprati-, aBijYA-jYAnaM, paricCedaH.
Ⓑ
 2 aMgI-svI-kAraH, pratipatti f., aByupagamaH.

Recoil,Ⓒv. i.Ⓓvi-parA-vft 1 A, vyapavft; parA-pat 1 P.
Ⓔs.Ⓓ(akasmAt) parA-vi-vartaH-rtanaM, parApatanaM.

Recollect,Ⓒv. t.Ⓓsmf 1 P, anu-saM-°, anu-DyE 1 P, anuciMt 10, anubuD 4 A, 1 P.
Ⓑ
 2 (Oneself) DEryaM avazwaMB 9 P or avalaMb 1 A; See Courage; ‘he tries to r(ecollect)’ su-smUrzate.
Ⓝ[Recollect]ion,Ⓒs.Ⓓsmfti f., smaraRaM, anu-ciMtanaM, anuboDaH; ‘I am a sage having r(ecollection) of my former birth’ ahaM jAtismaraH muniH (Ka. 355).

Recommend,Ⓒv. t.ⒹSlAG 1 A, praSas 1 P; See Praise.
Ⓑ
 2 nikzip 6 P, saM-, f c. (arpayati); See Entrust; stutipUrvakaM ni-kzip or upanyas 4 U; or gen. ex. by stu 2 U, praSas; guRAn praSaMs; ‘I r(ecommend) this boy to your care’ ayaM bAlako BavatAvekzaRIya iti me vinatiH; ‘I shall, therefore, r(ecommend) you to Damayanti’ tadahaM vidaDe tava stavaM damayaMtyAH saviDe (N. ii. 47); ‘I beg to r(ecommend) him to your kind notice’ tasmin kfpAdfzwiM pAtayatu or taM snigDadfzwyA paSyatu BavAn iti me prArTanA.
Ⓝ[Recommend]ation,Ⓒs.ⒹguRavarRanaM-praSaMsA-kIrtanaM.
Ⓑ
 2 guRavarRanapatraM, praSaM-sAleKaH.
Ⓑ
 3 upadeSaH, anuSAsanaM, praboDanaM.
Ⓑ
 4 anugraha-prasAda-kAraRaM, AdarahetuH ‘a fair face is a good r(ecommendation)’ AkftiviSezezvAdaraH padaM karoti (M. 1).
Ⓝ[Recommend]atory,Ⓒa.ⒹguRa-SlAGin, praSaMsAkarin.

Recompense,Ⓒv. t.ⒹSuD c., nizkf 8 U, pratikf, pratiPalaM-nizkftiM dA 3 U, nistF c.; (kzatiM) pUr 10 &c.; See Compensate.
Ⓑ
 2 mUlyaM dA; parituz c., saM-BU c.; See Reward.
Ⓔs.ⒹpAritozikaM, mUlyaM, pratiPalaM; nizkfti f., [] nistAraH, SudDi f., niryAtanaM, pratikriyA; pUraRaM; kzatinizkftiH-pUraRaM.

Reconcile,Ⓒv. t.ⒹsaM-DA 3 U, saM-Gaw c. (Gawayati), saMmil c., dvezaM-vEraM Sam c. (Samayati), saKyaM kf 8 U; prasad c., anunI 1 P, sAMtv 10, saM-pari-tuz c.; ‘you are not yet r(econcil)ed’ nAdyApi prasAdaM gfhRAsi (M. 4), na anunIyase, prasannA na Bavasi; ‘easy to be r(econcil)ed’ ASusaMDeya.
Ⓑ
 2 (Statement &c.) visaMvAdaM-viroDaM-apanI 1 P or apA-nirA-kf, EkyatAM-ekavAkyatAM-saMgatiM-kf, samA-DA.
Ⓑ
 3 (Quarrels &c.) praSam c., saM-DA, nirAkf.
Ⓝ[Reconcil]ed,Ⓒa.ⒹkftasaMDi, SAMtavEra, prasAdita, ekIkfta; ‘to be r(econciled)’ prasad 1 P, mEtryaM gam 1 P, pra-sAdaM grah 9 U, tozaM gam, saMmil 6 P.
Ⓝ[Reconcil]er,Ⓒs.ⒹsaMDAtf m., samADAtA, saMDikft m.
Ⓝ[Reconcile]ment, Reconciliation,Ⓒs.ⒹsaMDAnaM, saMGawanaM, prasAdanaM, saMmelanaM, vEraSamanaM, saKya-karaRaM.
Ⓑ
 2 saMDiH, sAman n., vEraSAMti f., punaH saKyaM-mEtrI, sAMtvanaM, anunayaH, EkyaM.
Ⓑ
 3 samA-DAnaM, saMgati f., ekavAkyatA, viroDaSamanaM.
Recondite,Ⓒa.Ⓓgahana, ni-, gUQa, gUQArTa, durboDa, rahasya, durjYeya, gahanArTa.
Reconnoitre,Ⓒv. t.ⒹnipuRaM-sUkzmaM-parIkz 1 A or nirUp 10 or anusaM-DA 3 U, gavez 10.

Record,Ⓒs.ⒹleKyaM, leKaH, patraM, patrakaM, pawwaH, leKapramARaM (‘evidence on r(ecord)’).
Ⓔv. t.ⒹABi-, liK 6 P, leKye-patre-Aruh c. or niviS c. or f c. (arpayati); See Commit.
Ⓝ[Record]er,Ⓒs.ⒹleKakaH, lipikAraH, kAyasTaH (court-officer).
Recount,Ⓒv. t.ⒹkaT 10, AKyA 2 P, varR 10, nivid c., pari-, kFt 10; See Tell.
Recoup,Ⓒv. t.ⒹpUr 10, prativi-DA 3 U, pUnar laB 1 A.

Recourse,Ⓒs.ⒹA-saM-upA-SrayaH, A-ava-laMbaH,
Ⓑ
 2 SaraRaM, gati f., (SrIharirme gatiH) f.; ‘have r(ecourse) to’ Sri 1 U, A-upA-samA-saM°, AsTA 1 P, A-ava-laMb 1 A; upagam 1 P.

Recover,Ⓒv. i.ⒹArogyaM laB 1 A, rogAd vimuc pass.; oft. by nir, vi, gata in comp.; nirvizaH gOtamaH (M. 4), ‘has r(ecover)ed from (the effects of) poison’; prakftiM Apad 4 A, susTa-prakftisTa a. BU 1 P, rogamukta-nirAmaya- a. BU; pUrvasTitiM prAp 5 P.
Ⓑ
 2 (From fainting) saMjYAM-ce-tanAM-laB; See below.
Ⓔv. t.Ⓓ(punaH) laB, prAp, vid 6 U, prati-A-pad; pratyavAp, pratyA-dA 3 A, pratigrah 9 P, pratyAhf 1 P, pratyudDf 1 P; ‘r(ecover) consciousness’ saMjYAM-cetanAM-laB or prAp, prakftiM-saMjYAM prati-A-pad, prakftisTa a. BU.
Ⓑ
 2 rogaM hf or naS c. or sAD c. or Sam c., nIruja-svasTa- a. kf 8 U; See Cure; ‘she r(ecover)ed him from poison’ sA taM nirvizaM cakAra.
Ⓝ[Recover]ed,Ⓒa.ⒹpratilabDa, pra-tyAhfta, punargfhIta, &c.
Ⓑ
 2 (From sickness) gata-nazwa-SAMta-roga, nIroga, nirAmaya, rogamukta, svasTa, prakftisTa, utTita; oft. by mukta, gata, in comp.; ‘r(ecovered) from fever’ jvaramukta; ‘r(ecovered) from swooning’ nazwa-gata-moha; ‘r(ecovered) from poison’ nirviza, &c.
Ⓑ
 3 (From fainting) labDa-saMjYa-cetana, prakfti-mApanna, prakftisTa, cetanApanna.
Ⓝ[Recover]y,Ⓒs.ⒹpunarlABaH, punaHprApti f., punarAdAnaM, pratipatti f., aDigamanaM, pratyudDAraH.
Ⓑ
 2 svAsTyalABaH; ArogyaprAptiH, prakftilABaH, svAsTyaM, nirA-mayatvaM, ArogyaM, rogamukti f.

Recreant,Ⓒa.ⒹDarmaBrazwa, tyakta-laMGita-svaDarma, patita.
Ⓑ
 2 kAtara, BIru, klIba; See Coward.

Recreate,Ⓒv. t.Ⓓ(Oneself) viSram 4 P, vihf 1 P, ram 1 A, krIq 1 P.
Ⓑ
 2 A-samA-pratyA-Svas c., AnaMd c., vinud c., ram c. (ramayati), saM-pari-tuz c.; See Please, Refresh.
Ⓝ[Recreat]ion,Ⓒs.ⒹviSrAmaH, vinodaH-danaM, vihAraH, viharaRaM, krIqA, kOtukaM, manoraMjanaM.
Ⓝ[Recreat]ive,Ⓒa.ⒹsuKakara (rI f.), manoraMjana (nI f.), vinodaSIla.
Recrement,Ⓒs.ⒹSee Dross.

Recriminate,Ⓒv.ⒹpratyaBiyuj 7 A, 10, pra-tyaBiSaMs 1 P.
Ⓝ[Recriminat]ion,Ⓒs.ⒹpratyaBiyogaH, pra-tyAropaH; ‘crimination and r(ecrimination)’ paraspara-dozAropaH.
Ⓝ[Recriminat]ive, [Recriminat]ory,Ⓒa.ⒹpratyaBiyogin.

Recrudescence,Ⓒs.ⒹpunaH prasarpaRaM or udBavaH.
ⓃRecrudescent,Ⓒa.ⒹpunaH prasarpin.

Recruit,Ⓒv. t.ⒹSaktiM vfD c., prabalIkf 8 U, ASvas c., ApyE c., samA-pratisamA-DA 3 U, susTa- a. kf; ‘to r(ecruit) the strength of’ vAjIkf.
Ⓑ
 2 navasEnikEH pUr 10.
Ⓔv. i.Ⓓ‘r(ecruit) oneʼs strength’ balaM-sattvaM laB 1 A, sva-tejaH-vIryaM prAp 5 P, susTa- a. BU.
Ⓔs.ⒹnUtana-nava-sEnikaH.
Ⓝ[Recruit]ed,Ⓒa.ⒹlabDa-prApta-bala, varDita-sattva, ApyAyita, pratyASvasta.
Ⓑ
 2 navasEnika-yukta-pUrRa.

Rectangle,Ⓒs.ⒹsamakoRaH, samacaturasraM.
ⓃRectangular,Ⓒa.ⒹsamakoRa, samacaturasra.

Rectify,Ⓒv. t.ⒹsamA-pratisamA-DA 3 U, SuD c.
Ⓝ[Rectif]ication,Ⓒs.ⒹsamADAnaM, SoDanaM.
Rectilineal,Ⓒa.ⒹsaralareKAviSizwa.

Rectitude,Ⓒs.ⒹsAralyaM, ArjavaM, dAkziRyaM, nyA-yitA, SOcaM, satyaSIlatA, sadvartanaM, sadAcAraH; ‘path of r(ectitude)’ sanmArgaH, supaTaH, nItimArgaH-paTaH; ‘deviation from the path of r(ectitude)’ satpaTatyAgaH-BraMSaH, utpaTagamanaM.

Rector,Ⓒs.ⒹnAyakaH, aDyakzaH.
Ⓑ
 2 grAmAcAryaH.
Recumbent,Ⓒa.ⒹpArSvaSaya, arDakAyena SayAna, kukziSaya, saMvizwa.
Recuperate,Ⓒv. t.Ⓓpunar laB 1 A.

Recur,Ⓒv. i.Ⓓprati-, A-vft 1 A, punar Agam 1 P, or Apat 1 P or saM-pad 4 A or saM-BU 1 P or Gaw 1 A or upasTA 1 P; (to the mind) AviH-prAduH-BU, ud-i 2 P, sPur 6 P, smf pass.
Ⓑ
 2 SaraRaM gam or prapad.
Ⓝ[Recur]rence, [Recur]rency,Ⓒs.ⒹpratyAvftti f., punarvartanaM, punarGawanaM-ApAtaH-upasTAnaM-saMBavaH.
Ⓑ
 2 smaraRaM, sPuraRaM, prAdurBAvaH, udayaH.
Ⓝ[Recur]rent, [Recur]ring,Ⓒa.ⒹAvartaka, pratyAvartin.
Recusant,Ⓒa.ⒹpratIpa; See Obstinate.
